answer: The vertex register is checked at draw time, ferrous lists the eligible set, and relic seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 25 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 25 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Collateral of 78 dollars is at risk. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
